feature: Customer Portal v2 -- the Document Library (/portal-v2/documents), the fourth of the design handoff's five systems and the first non-pillar page in the v2 build. Recreated from 'Customer Portal Shell.dc.html': the isDocuments section (proto 5470-5679), the right slide-out filter drawer (5645-5679) and the derivation behind both (11487-11930). Git #1346 removed the 24-document design-forward catalogue (DOC-10..33) from what the customer sees -- the page now renders only the 9 owned documents (DOC-01..09), which are the real deliverables that exist as a product today. The fixture (components/portal-v2/docLibraryData.ts) was EXTRACTED mechanically from the prototype rather than retyped; the derived behaviour (components/portal-v2/docLibraryModel.ts) was transcribed by hand and is what these steps and the unit test both aim at.
notes: Git #1443 -- the amber 'out of date' band (DOC-01, DOC-03) and the Cover's 'Issued 3 Aug 2026'/'Signed 6 Aug 2026' subtitle were the prototype's fictional Halden Materials fixture (DOC_OWNED_META's fresh/freshNote, DOC_LIB's own issue date), shown identically to every real tenant regardless of their own scan. Every owned document renders live from the tenant's own current scan data at open time (Git #643) -- there is no stored generation timestamp for one to go stale against -- so docLibraryModel.ts no longer carries fresh/freshNote/issued onto a real DocRow at all; docStateFor() always reports the true state, 'Current'. The Cover's date now comes from view.tenant.scannedOn. DL8/DL8b assert this.

Git #1346 -- hide, don't disclose. Shane: the ~24 documents beyond what a customer actually owns were shown with disclosure copy ('This library shows X of Y documents. The remainder cover workloads not in your tenant...') that read as a browsable catalogue rather than what it was -- the same 'hide, don't disclose' precedent as #1341's Directory Sync panel. This build filters `ALL_DOCS` in docLibraryModel.ts down to the owned nine, removes the Availability facet (In your library / Available to add) that existed only to distinguish owned from catalogue rows, and removes the cart / 'Add to your library' / price-block UI along with it, since none of it is reachable once there are no unowned rows to add. The footer's 'X of Y documents' sentence and the filter drawer's 'The rest are written the same way... and can be added at any time' sentence are both gone.

Git #1238 (unchanged by #1346): DOC-01..09's expanded body content is the REAL live report body, ported from `DocumentBody.tsx`'s LIVE_BODY registry -- the same components `/copilot-readiness/documents` mounts, reused directly via `useCopilotJourney()` + `withLiveDocuments()` + `<DocumentBody>`, matched to each owned row by title.

SCOPE: the Document Library page only. It is a FIXTURE page for its metadata (title/pillar/type/audience/offering) -- there is no /api/portal/documents endpoint yet, so there is deliberately no API assertion here beyond the login that every /portal-v2/* probe needs.

THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute. A probe that goes straight to the page without the five login steps below hits the login screen and every assertion fails for a reason that has nothing to do with the page.

UI ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/documents. App.tsx declares '/portal-v2/documents' BEFORE '/portal-v2/:pillar' so the param route cannot swallow it.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- these steps only exercise the page once this commit is deployed to the dev server.

DL18-DL21 ARE THE POINT OF THIS MANIFEST NOW. A faceted search whose option counts are computed WITH their own group applied looks entirely normal until you tick one box and every sibling in that group reads 0. DL19 ticks Security (1 of the 9 owned documents) and DL21 then asserts Governance still reads its own unfiltered count of 1 -- the count it would return if Security were not ticked. Full ordering across all 9 rows under every sort is covered by src/components/portal-v2/docLibraryModel.test.ts, not here, since under no filter every sort happens to put DOC-01 first among only 9 rows (it is owned, Cross-pillar, and a Report) and there is no longer a catalogue subset to filter into that would make the sorts visibly diverge in the UI.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD -- the same testbed account portal-v2-pillars.json drives.

WAIT for the login form to hydrate before typing.
Primary login -- every assertion below needs a real authenticated session.
goto the Document Library on its slug-scoped route.
DL1 -- the sticky bar renders, so the route resolved to the Library and not to NotFound or the param pillar route.

DL3 -- Git #1346: the old owned/available breakdown ('9 owned · 24 available to add') is gone entirely -- there is nothing to disclose about a hidden catalogue any more.

DL6 -- Git #1238: DOC-01's expanded body is the REAL live Copilot Readiness report body, ported from DocumentBody.tsx's LIVE_BODY registry -- not the docLibraryData.ts fixture's headline/facts/sections. Content varies per tenant scan, so only presence of the ported body's wrapper is asserted here.

It used to carry the fictional Halden Materials fixture's freshNote ('Telemetry moved since 3 Aug') for every real tenant regardless of what actually happened in their own scan; docLibraryModel.ts no longer carries fresh/freshNote onto a real row at all, so this testid never renders.

DL21 -- THE FACET-COUNT RULE. With Security ticked, Governance still reads its own unfiltered count of 1 -- the count it would return if Security were not ticked -- because a group's counts are computed with its OWN group skipped. Counting with the group included would show 0 here and turn the drawer into a filter that can only narrow.

DL27 -- while DOC-02, which is Security, survives it.
DL28 -- remove the chip.
DL29 -- and the library is whole again.
DL30 -- search narrows to a single document by number.
DL31 -- search for DOC-05.
